## The Will of D.

Roger, Garp, Dragon, Luffy, Ace, Law, Teach. Every Celestial Dragon fears the initial, and nobody will say why.

Reach 40,000 Doriki and land on God Valley, the island the World Government erased.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Carrier of the Will](r_traits.md#q-223b080cf7cee585)

**Tasks**

- Reach 40,000 Doriki
- Land on God Valley

**Rewards**

- Doriki +780, Belly +60,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Golden Box

## Borrowed Blood

Vegapunk built Seraphim out of Lineage Factors. Whoever ate his Nomi Nomi no Mi can sample a creature's or a people's blood and graft its trait onto another body.

Have a Lineage Factor grafted onto you. Up to three grafted traits are stable; every one past that costs a tenth of your health and weakens all of them.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Have a Lineage Factor grafted onto you

**Rewards**

- Doriki +300, Belly +25,000
